meta.title: The Lantern Cellar
meta.description: A tiny two-room example game that ships as the playground template. Every value below is a working example of what goes in that field — copy this file and replace each piece with your own.

rooms.name: Cellar Door
rooms.description: A damp stairwell ends at a heavy oak door. An unlit lantern hangs from a rusted hook beside it, and a dark passage leads down into the wine cellar.

rooms.name: Wine Cellar
rooms.description: Racks of dusty bottles line the walls. High above the far stairs, a thin stripe of daylight outlines an iron grate.

actions.label: Climb out through the grate
actions.description: With the lantern lit you can see the footholds up to the grate.
actions.failMessage: It is too dark to find the footholds. You need light first.
actions.successMessage: You climb the racks, ease the grate open, and pull yourself toward the light.

items.name: Box of Matches
items.examineText: The striker strip is dry. These will light.

steps.description: The lantern wick is dry. A match would catch it — if you had one.

action.label: Light the Lantern
action.failMessage: The wick needs a flame. Something in this room could strike one.

effects.name: lantern-lit
effects.message: The lantern flares to life, throwing warm light up the stairwell and down into the cellar.

hints.text: The lantern is the way forward, but it cannot burn on its own. Pick up whatever could light it, then press the event's action button.
hints.highlightText: An unlit lantern hangs from a rusted hook

endings.title: Into the Light
endings.text: You squeeze through the grate and stand up in the afternoon sun. The cellar keeps its damp secrets; you keep the matches.
